# Artwork fixtures

Retrieved 2026-09-06 from the existing TCGdex catalog for visual regression testing:

- https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/en/cards/ex15-43 — Bagon δ
- https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/en/cards/ex14-4 — Charizard δ

Each `.webp` comes from the corresponding metadata's `image` URL plus `/high.webp`.
These are reference images, not proof of a particular stamped/condition/edition variant.
Artwork belongs to its respective rights holders. Fixtures are test assets, not new runtime card mappings.
Prices in the browser scenarios are synthetic and do not claim current market values.
